name: estulanches
description: EstuLanches — plataforma de gestão de cantina escolar (painel administrativo + app do estudante).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.setup: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
